translations.A Carmelite nun, Thérèse taught that hol: A Carmelite nun, Thérèse taught that holiness can be found in ordinary acts of love. Her “Little Way” encouraged trust in God and faithfulness in small things.
translations.A Dominican lay brother in Lima, Martin: A Dominican lay brother in Lima, Martin served the sick and poor with humility and compassion. He is remembered for his care for people across social divisions.
translations.A Dominican tertiary and mystic, Catheri: A Dominican tertiary and mystic, Catherine devoted herself to prayer, service to the sick, and peacemaking. Her counsel and letters made her an influential voice in the Church.

translations.After a long search for truth, Augustine: After a long search for truth, Augustine became a Christian, a priest, and the bishop of Hippo. His writings, including Confessions, reflect on grace, conversion, and the restless heart seeking God.
translations.After giving up a life of wealth, Franci: After giving up a life of wealth, Francis embraced poverty and founded the Order of Friars Minor. His love for creation and care for the poor continue to inspire a life of simplicity and peace.
translations.As Archbishop of San Salvador, Romero sp: As Archbishop of San Salvador, Romero spoke out against violence and injustice and stood with people suffering oppression. He was killed while celebrating Mass in 1980.

translations.Benedict shaped Western monastic life th: Benedict shaped Western monastic life through a Rule that balances prayer, work, hospitality, and community. His teaching continues to guide Benedictine monasteries around the world.

translations.Glory be to the Father, and to the Son,: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
translations.God of this new morning, I offer you the: God of this new morning, I offer you the thoughts, words, work, and encounters of this day. Bless what is good, guide what is uncertain, and help me meet each person with patience and love. May all I do draw me closer to you. Amen.
translations.Gracious God, thank you for the gifts an: Gracious God, thank you for the gifts and graces of this day, both seen and unseen. Receive the work left unfinished and the worries I carry. Forgive my failures, bless those I love, and grant us peaceful rest beneath your loving care. Amen.
translations.Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is wi: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
translations.Hold this mystery in your heart as you p: Hold this mystery in your heart as you pray one Our Father, ten Hail Marys, and one Glory Be.
translations.I am also the founder of Lumen Orientale: I am also the founder of Lumen Orientale, where I write about Catholic liturgy, ecclesiastical history, and developments in the Church. Through writing and digital publishing, I hope to make the Church’s traditions better understood while remaining faithful to her teachings and communion with the Holy See.
translations.I combine my background in information t: I combine my background in information technology with my commitment to the Church through website development, Catholic communications, and digital projects. Veritas is my latest initiative: a prayer app intended to make traditional and contemporary devotional resources more accessible and to encourage daily prayer, reflection, and a deeper relationship with God.
translations.I consent to publishing my name, locatio: I consent to publishing my name, location, and prayer intention for all visitors to see.
translations.Inspired by Francis of Assisi, Clare fou: Inspired by Francis of Assisi, Clare founded the Order of Poor Ladies, now known as the Poor Clares. She chose a life of prayer, poverty, and service in community.
translations.Jesus, companion of the suffering, draw: Jesus, companion of the suffering, draw near to all who are sick and those who care for them. Bring relief where there is pain, strength where there is weariness, and hope where the way feels long. Help me serve with tenderness and trust in your mercy. Amen.
Made for a little more stillness.
translations.My God, I am sorry for my sins with all: My God, I am sorry for my sins with all my heart. In choosing to do wrong and failing to do good, I have sinned against you, whom I should love above all things. I firmly intend, with your help, to do penance, to sin no more, and to avoid whatever leads me to sin. Amen.
translations.My mission is to bring the timeless trea: My mission is to bring the timeless treasures of Catholic spirituality to everyday life, using faith, liturgical knowledge, writing, and technology in the service of the Church and a new generation.
translations.My name is Chavez Cyrillus Mariae Long H: My name is Chavez Cyrillus Mariae Long Hei Poon. I am a Traditionalist Roman Catholic lay Acolyte, Liturgical Master of Ceremonies, freelance writer, and Catholic digital content creator based in England. Born and educated in Hong Kong, I have served the Church for more than a decade as an Acolyte, Sacristan, and Liturgical Master of Ceremonies. This service has deepened my appreciation for the Sacred Liturgy, ecclesiastical history, and the spiritual heritage of the Roman Catholic Church.

Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
translations.Prince of Peace, quiet what is restless: Prince of Peace, quiet what is restless within me. Give courage to those who work for reconciliation, comfort to those living through conflict, and wisdom to those entrusted with difficult choices. Make me a patient listener and a small instrument of your peace. Amen.
